data.scope: Loopback. WebTransport uses pinned TLS and graceful stream close; legacy WebSocket uses plaintext and Close/EOF. Real connected CBOR users in small rooms. All live welcome IDs unique; every stable user routes a complete independently checked private ring message before measurement. Selected rooms send configurable payloads at staggered per-user deadlines. Optional additional rooms complete paced join/ring/Close/EOF cycles while the stable population remains connected. Inactive sockets answer heartbeat Pings. Full sender/body/sequence and exact counters checked. Round-trip includes client sending and verification; logarithmic quantiles are upper bounds. Scheduling lag and churn lifecycle measured separately. Authenticated management is polled during traffic. Every Close acknowledgement, EOF and room departure is checked. Process/descriptor/TCP or independent QUIC-connection scans are quiescent gates outside traffic. Global socket/slab measurements include both clients and unrelated machine activity; server RSS excludes kernel socket memory. Heartbeat policy and bounded message/queue/staging limits recorded in server_command.

data.scope: Gated setup/mixed workload/cleanup. Stable single-member rooms include binary and Unicode names, private pairs have distinct rooms, health0 keeps a variable. Inspectors use authenticated HTTP or CBOR on a fixed per-worker interval, skipping missed ticks; every name, member count, field, ordering and complete response is verified. During churn, known churn rooms may appear with one member; quiescent snapshots before and after must contain exactly the stable rooms. Healthy traffic uses 64 cyclic private templates at args.private_payload_bytes (default 1 KiB) and 16-message windows; fanout remains 1 KiB; full sender/value/FIFO checked. Churn verifies welcome, exact 8-byte-counter self delivery, normal Close and EOF. All stable peers stay connected until the mixed workload ends; every close and final resource/counter/byte total is checked. Latencies include client-side verification and competing client tasks on separate CPU cores. Native CPU covers all mixed work, not an isolated cost per delivery. Loopback; WebTransport uses pinned TLS, legacy WebSocket is plaintext. Rates/heartbeat disabled, default queues. Event-boundary RSS is not continuous peak or allocated bytes. Profiles excluded from timing medians.

import sys,json,argparse,subprocess,os
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'artifacts/webtransport';sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
import inspection
original=subprocess.Popen;client=[None];roles={}
def popen(cmd,*a,**kw):
 if cmd[0]=='perf':
  cmd=list(cmd);index=cmd.index('-p');roles['server']=int(cmd[index+1]);roles['client']=client[0]
  assert roles['client'];cmd[index+1]+=','+str(roles['client']);cmd[cmd.index('-e')+1]='cycles';cmd[cmd.index('-F')+1]='249';cmd+=['-m','512'];cmd=['sudo','-n']+cmd
 p=original(cmd,*a,**kw)
 if any(Path(str(x)).name=='inspection' for x in cmd):client[0]=p.pid
 return p
subprocess.Popen=popen
for v in ['empty-packet-tree','quic-recordless']:
 client[0]=None;roles.clear()
 source=out/'thin-pending-final-mixed.json';a=json.loads(source.read_text())['args'];a.update(server=str(out/f'binaries/{v}-relay'),profile=True,seconds=8,output=str(out/f'quic-recordless-reliable-mixed-{v}-profile.json'))
 for k in ['server','client','client_source_root','tls_front','tls_cert','tls_key','tls_ca','heap_profile','heap_library','output','fanout_latency_output']:
  if a.get(k) is not None:a[k]=Path(a[k])
 r=inspection.run(argparse.Namespace(**a));assert r['passed'];data=a['output'].with_suffix('.perf.data')
 for role,pid in roles.items():
  text=subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','perf','report','--stdio','--no-children','-g','none','--pid',str(pid),'--sort','dso,symbol','--percentage','relative','--percent-limit','0.3','-i',str(data)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
  assert 'Total Lost Samples: 0' in text
  (out/f'quic-recordless-reliable-{v}-{role}-symbols.txt').write_text(text)
 (out/f'quic-recordless-reliable-{v}-profile-roles.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(roles),indent=2))
 subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','chown',f'{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}',str(data)],check=True)
 print('DONE',v,roles,flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,subprocess,tarfile,shutil
source=Path('vendor/rustls/src/tls13/key_schedule.rs');saved=source.read_bytes();out=Path('artifacts/webtransport')
try:
 with tarfile.open('target/vendor-source-cache/rustls-0.23.46.crate') as archive:
  original=archive.extractfile('rustls-0.23.46/src/tls13/key_schedule.rs').read()
 source.write_bytes(original)
 with (out/'quic-recordless-vendor-control-build.log').open('x') as log:
  subprocess.run(['cargo','build','--release'],stdout=log,stderr=log,check=True)
 shutil.copy2('target/release/war-relay',out/'binaries/quic-recordless-vendor-control-relay')
finally:
 source.write_bytes(saved)
with (out/'quic-recordless-restored-build.log').open('x') as log:
 subprocess.run(['cargo','build','--release'],stdout=log,stderr=log,check=True)
assert Path('target/release/war-relay').read_bytes()==(out/'binaries/quic-recordless-relay').read_bytes()
print('CONTROL',hashlib.sha256((out/'binaries/quic-recordless-vendor-control-relay').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
print('RESTORED',hashlib.sha256(Path('target/release/war-relay').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
